Executive Order

AMENDING CopDE oF Fair COMPETITION FOR THE DISTILLED SPIRITS
REcTIFYING INDUSTRY

WHEREAS the Federal Alcohol Control Administration has submitted for
my approval amendments to the Code of Fair Competition for the Distilled Spirits
Rectifying Industry and has rendered its report and recommendations and find-
ings thereon; and

WHEREAS due notice of public hearing on said proposed amendments has
been given and a public hearing thereon has been held pursuant to such notice;

NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in
me by Title I of the National Industrial Recovery Act of June 16, 1933 (ch. 90,
48 Stat. 195), and in order to effectuate the purposes of said Title, I hereby approve
said amendments and modify my previous approval of the Code of Fair Competi-
tion for the Distilled Spirits Rectifying Industry to include an approval of said
Code in its entirety as hereby amended.
